summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of Rush Bite (Kedai Burger Matematik) with Playwright at 1920x1080 and 1920x800, using ?speed=10 and ?seed= for shift-end tests. Almost all requested flows work and there were no console/page errors in any run. Tested: main menu (all 5 test ids, BM text, Continue disabled with no save, new-game confirm dialog when a save exists), the full tutorial (9 steps through grill flip/remove, assembly, fryer, drinks fill 91%, packing, deliver 5 stars, tutorial-start-shift; save gets tutorialDone=true), tutorial-skip and replay from How to Play, wrong bill (bill-feedback shown, input cleared, ticket patience 99.9%->87.7%, hud-math-score 0%, funds unchanged), hints (line totals, then RM22.20 total, then 'Baki perlu diberi: RM0.80'), Undo/Clear/Recount (denom-left 100->98->99->100, recount RM0.90), too much change ('Baki terlebih RM0.10', shortages RM0.10), too little ('Baki kurang RM1.00', penalty RM2.00), exact-payment button (RM0.00 counted correct), stations show only paid orders (order-picker-empty before payment, Alt+digit switches station on bill step), burnt patty (Hangus + grill-discard-0, discard frees slot), burnt fries (Hangus + fryer-discard-0, no remove button), pack warning dialog (review closes it, serve-anyway delivers with 1 star, 0 accuracy, 50% refund), pause (timer frozen at 3:22 for 2.5s, Esc/P toggle, resume, quit to menu), real shift at 10x (customers spawn, leave when ignored, timer counts down, 'Masa tambahan' grace 0:30->0:01, then Syif Tamat and summary), and the summary ledger: sales 50.20 - refunds 50.20 - shortages 0.10 - penalties 2.00 = net -2.10 OK; 300.00 - 2.10 - 25.00 = 272.90 OK. Summary has separate maths and food boxes, a worked example and an unlock note. Next Day starts Hari 2, and Continue after reload resumes Hari 2. Also checked: 'Perniagaan berisiko' warning, insolvent warning after one shift at or below RM0, bankruptcy after the second (bankrupt-panel, summary-restart-business, menu bankrupt-notice, Continue disabled), settings persist after reload (guided/santai/large/RM/HC/volume 60), Guided mode shows line totals, Credits and back-button. At 1920x800 the page has no overflow; the station panel scrolls inside.

ui_bugs.issue: Pressing Esc with pack-warning-dialog open closes the dialog and also opens the Pause menu. Digit keys 1-7 also switch stations behind the open modal. The global keydown handler does not ignore input while a modal is open.
The last tutorial step always says 'Syif sebenar bermula sekarang dalam Mod Cabaran' even when the mode is Guided or Mental (seen with Mod Berpandu).

issues: unlock-note ('Hari 2: Baharu: ...') is rendered outside the min-h-screen summary container, so at 1080 height it sits at the very bottom, far below the action buttons. Move it into SummaryScreen near the Next Day button.
'(kurangkan bonus)' text inside the hint button is 10px muted and hard to read.

action_items: In ShiftScreen useKeys, return early when s.packWarn is set (or when a [role=alertdialog] is open) so that Esc and digit keys do not pause the game or switch stations behind the pack warning dialog
Make the last tutorial step text depend on the mode (or remove the hardcoded 'Mod Cabaran')
Move the unlock note into SummaryScreen layout, above or beside the action buttons
critical_code_review_comments: Tutorial order revenue, tips and stats (math score 100%, streak 1) carry into the Day 1 real shift ledger and summary, because TUTORIAL_FINISH keeps the ledger and stats. Decide whether that is intended; if not, reset ledger and stats on TUTORIAL_FINISH.

commitPayment under-change: if makeChange(-diff, drawer) returns null, the drawer is not debited for the returned difference but the ledger assumes it was. Rare, but the drawer count and cash can drift.
The hint button label says '(kurangkan bonus)' but hints only halve the tip (tipFor) and do not affect the streak bonus. The wording may mislead.
Main-menu and summary rb-rise animations make content look faded when a screenshot is taken right after navigation. This is cosmetic only.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests inject localStorage rushbite_save_v1 directly (e.g. {day:1,funds:30000,tutorialDone:true}) to skip the tutorial, and funds 1000 to test bankruptcy.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use ?speed=10&seed=N for deterministic fast shifts (a day takes about 30s real time). Inject a save via localStorage to skip the tutorial. Summary values are shown with a '−' prefix on deduction rows (it is a sign label, not a negative value). Grill and fryer status text is in grill-status-0 / fryer-status-0; poll for 'Terbalikkan sekarang!' / 'Sedia'. Exact-tender orders occur often (seed 12345, first order).
